summary: The flow takes attacker-controlled input from request.getParameter("name") and writes it directly into the HTML response via response.getWriter().println, allowing reflected XSS (CWE-80). The fix HTML-encodes the tainted data in the bad() action method before it is written into the HTML output context, neutralizing markup-significant characters (&, <, >, ", ') while still displaying the user's value. Valid inputs continue to be echoed back; only their rendering is made safe.
